inclusions.source: A private air-conditioned vehicle and a licensed Egyptologist guide handle the transfers between sites, which is worth noting because Cairo traffic is not a minor variable — it is a daily renegotiation, and having someone who knows the city is the difference between arriving composed and arriving frayed.

exclusions.text: Complete Tutankhamun collection (Grand Egyptian Museum) and royal mummies (NMEC) are separate visits
exclusions.source: If your priority is the complete Tutankhamun collection (now at the Grand Egyptian Museum, Giza) or the royal mummies (now at the NMEC in Old Cairo), those are separate visits and we will sequence them properly across two days rather than try to force them into this one.
